messages:
kira: Heads up, immediate action required — our signing telemetry detected suspicious use of the internal code-signing key `cs-rt-prod-1` last night. Need coordinated rotation + audit.
sec-bot: [AUTO] Alert: anomalous signing activity for key cs-rt-prod-1 at 2026-03-20T19:42:03Z. Unusual subject: CI runner eu-west-1.
sam: Any sign of exfil or just a stale token?
kira: Not confirmed exfil. Logs show a runner spawned with a stale token. Plan: rotate private key, revoke runner tokens, and enforce a 1h signing freeze for releases.
maria: Blast radius? CI pipelines, CDN signing, release artifacts — we should alert partners.
jordan: Key used by Linux/macOS build pipelines + CDN signing. Rotation means new KMS key, update CI secrets, re-sign if needed. Old public key remains valid for verification until delegation published.
lee: Proposed steps: 1) create new KMS key (HSM-wrapped). 2) update ci/secrets/cs-rt-prod. 3) switch signing service to new key; keep old key verification-only for 7d. 4) revoke runner tokens from last 48h.
kira: Start rotation within 2h. Maria please draft partner comms. Jordan/Sam/Lee coordinate PRs. Oncall-ops standby for rollback.
oncall-ops: Acknowledged — paging oncall. Will standby for hotfix cut.
devops-bot: CI policy patch created and will block new releases until rotation completes.
sam: Suggested commands: `redwoodctl tokens list --scope=runner --since=72h`, `redwoodctl tokens revoke <id>`, `redwoodctl signing events --key cs-rt-prod-1 --since=48h`.
kira: Security asks each owner to post a one-line confirmation here after: created KMS key, updated CI secret, restarted signing service, revoked tokens. We will collect audit proofs.
maria: Draft partner message: "Precautionary key rotation for code-signing service; temporary pause on new releases (<=1h). No evidence of customer data compromise. Will follow up." Sending to legal.
jordan: Doing KMS + service switchover now. ETA 40m.
lee: Updating CI secrets now; will confirm when done.
sec-bot: [AUTO] Also flagged two unusual SSH sessions from build-runner-3 in eu-west-1. Security will open separate ticket if breakout evidence appears.
kira: Thanks all. Keep replies short — we'll run a postmortem after containment. :lock:
